title: skills(objectstack-query): the nested-relation condition is one subquery per relationship on a read verb, up to three relationships — retire the "up to 1000 related ids" / one-level text
body:
domain:server#5 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QwJJ5KGZTThP4fnq

Follow-up of #33626 (draft PR #33652). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is wrong

`skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` (the quick-reference row "Filter rows by their lookup target's column") and `skills/objectstack-query/rules/filters.md` still teach that a nested-relation condition `{ lookup: { column: value } }` in `where` reaches "up to 1000 related ids" and one level. After PR #33652:

- On `find` / `findOne` / `count` / `aggregate`, a single-valued relation is one in-database subquery per relationship (driver-sql dialects, Turso; driver-memory evaluates the same leaf in process). No id list, no cap.
- A relation key inside the condition may carry its own condition, down to ADR-0071's three relationships; a fourth, and the dotted spelling, are refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400.
- The 1000-id cap remains only where ids are read: a multi-valued relation, and `update` / `delete`.
- Each hop is read as the caller: a related record the caller cannot read at any hop excludes the row, `$ne` included.

## What lands

The skill text and its rules file say the above, in the same words as `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` (updated in #33652). Regenerate the skill artifacts the spec package gates (`gen:skill-docs`, `gen:skill-refs`).

## Grade and route

`skills/**` is a Tier H governed surface (AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14): the PR is authored by any seat and landed by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval. Fable-mandatory review per the seat's routing. Lands after #33652 merges.

Seam: spec:`skills/objectstack-query` text → runtime: `lowerRelationConditions` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-query-lowering.ts`).
